LESSON: RATES, RATIO, PROPORTIONS AND PERCENTAGES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.4 Squares and Square roots (6 lessons) Squares and square roots of num
Topic 1.5: Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify rates in different situations
2. compare two or more ratios in different situations
3. divide quantities in given ratios in real-life situations

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: RATES, RATIO, PROPORTIONS AND PERCENTAGES
Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify rates in different situations
2. compare two or more ratios in different situations
3. divide quantities in given ratios in real-life situations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
